authority: User ruling 2026-10-28: replaced Hand and Deck discards remain discard events; one trigger per discard action, not per card.

contracts.name: Forfog, the Hanged
contracts.printedParagraph: As long as Forfog is in the Interzone, whenever an opponent discards one or more cards, they lose 5 points.

contracts.name: Ehgog, the Livid
contracts.printedParagraph: As long as Ehgog is in the Interzone, whenever a player discards one or more cards, a target manifestation on the field controlled by an opponent gets -1 power until the end of the turn.

contracts.name: Pale Entity
contracts.printedParagraph: As long as Pale Entity is in the Interzone, whenever a player loses points or discards one or more cards, you gain 5 points.

contracts.name: Conflux of Catastrophe
contracts.printedParagraph: Whenever a player discards one or more cards, a target manifestation on the field controlled by an opponent gets -1 power.

contracts.name: Buddhan the Transcended
contracts.printedParagraph: When Buddhan the Transcended enters the field, put 3 Quiet counters on it and, as long as it is on the field, if due to cards or effects a manifestation loses power, a player discards cards or loses points, remove a Quiet counter from Buddhan the Transcended. When there are no Quiet counters on Buddhan the Transcended, it becomes of {H} temperament and gains: At the beginning of the turn, each player exiles a random manifestation from their Empathic Vessel.

contracts.name: Makaboon
contracts.printedParagraph: As long as Makaboon is on the field, whenever a player discards one or more cards from their deck, in addition that player discards a card from their hand.

contracts.name: Otranth, the Bloodthirsty
contracts.printedParagraph: Otranth enters the field with 2 Shackle counters on it. Whenever a manifestation enters a Limbo, remove 1 Shackle counter from Otranth and, as long as there are no Shackle counters on it, it has Support.

contracts.name: Kanon, the Deathdealer
contracts.printedParagraph: For each Will discarded this way, a target Manifestation on the field controlled by an opponent gets -1 power.
